raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Effective thickness of the 2D topology model",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 4.1 assign 1 cm explicitly for size optimization, without specifying the thickness used in the 2D topology stiffness calculation.",
      "readings": [
        "Use unit thickness of 1 mm for the 2D topology calculation.",
        "Use the later sizing thickness of 10 mm for the 2D topology calculation."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Continuum element family and dimensionality",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 1.3.1 specifies linear hexahedral elements, whereas Sec. 4.1 describes this cantilever using 150 × 52 × 1 linear quadrilateral elements. The element counts are supplied, but these element descriptions disagree.",
      "readings": [
        "A 150 × 52 mesh of four-node 2D quadrilateral elements.",
        "A 150 × 52 × 1 mesh of eight-node 3D hexahedral elements."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Constitutive assumption for the 2D quadrilateral interpretation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The Fig. 2 caption supplies Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio, but neither Sec. 1.3.1 nor the cantilever descriptions specify plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress with the stated elastic constants.",
        "Plane strain with the stated elastic constants."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Element integration and stabilization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 1.3.1 and 4.1 identify linear elements without specifying quadrature or hourglass control.",
      "readings": [
        "Full integration: 2 × 2 Gauss points for quadrilaterals or 2 × 2 × 2 for hexahedra.",
        "One-point reduced integration with hourglass stabilization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "100 kN point force at the opposite free end",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 4.1 state the magnitude and in-plane position but no force components or angle. Resolving the direction would require the unavailable problem sketch.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward in the plate plane.",
        "Horizontally outward along the 150 cm span.",
        "At 45 degrees downward and outward in the plate plane."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Through-thickness position of the force under the hexahedral interpretation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 4.1 uniquely locate the force in-plane, but give no through-thickness coordinate if the stated hexahedral discretization is followed.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the point force at the midsurface, z/t = 0.5, using consistent equivalent nodal forces.",
        "Apply the entire point force at a surface node, z/t = 0."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Continuum regions forced to remain solid",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 specifies no passive-element mask. The tagging in Secs. 2.2.4 and 4.1 concerns skeleton/frame preservation and does not define fixed continuum densities or their extent.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive elements; optimize every element density.",
        "Keep only the load-adjacent element solid.",
        "Keep a one-element-wide strip along the clamp and the load-adjacent element solid."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume fraction in the later detailed repeat of the Fig. 2 cantilever",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Fig. 2 explicitly labels separate runs at 0.7, 0.5 and 0.3. However, the Sec. 4.1 repeat supplying implementation details states 0.5 in its prose while its Fig. 12 caption states 0.3.",
      "readings": [
        "Use Vf = 0.5 for the detailed repeat, following Sec. 4.1 prose.",
        "Use Vf = 0.3 for the detailed repeat, following the Fig. 12 caption."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Units of filter radius R = 1.2",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The Fig. 2 caption and Sec. 4.1 give R = 1.2 without units or a coordinate normalization. Eq. (7) measures distances between element centers.",
      "readings": [
        "R = 1.2 element pitches, equivalent to 12 mm on a uniform 150 × 52 mesh.",
        "R = 1.2 mm in a physical N–mm coordinate convention."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Forward density-filter formula",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Eq. (6) places rho_i inside the sum over j, making the normalized expression equal rho_i. The surrounding filtering description and the nonlocal derivative in Eq. (12) instead imply averaging neighboring rho_j values.",
      "readings": [
        "Implement Eq. (6) literally: rho_hat_i = rho_i, with no forward density smoothing.",
        "Replace rho_i in the numerator by rho_j and apply the normalized neighbor-density filter."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density used in SIMP compliance sensitivities",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 1.3.1 says filtered densities replace the design densities in the physical problem, but Eqs. (11) and (13) print the penalization derivative using unfiltered rho_j rather than rho_hat_j.",
      "readings": [
        "Differentiate the filtered stiffness consistently using p times rho_hat_j raised to p−1, followed by the filter chain rule.",
        "Use the printed p times rho_j raised to p−1 factor with the filtered finite-element solution."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Topology optimization algorithm",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 1.3.1 provides gradients but no topology density-update algorithm. MMA and SQP are identified in Secs. 2.4 and 4.1 for size/layout optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria density updates.",
        "Method of Moving Asymptotes.",
        "Sequential Quadratic Programming."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial density field and initialization across Fig. 2 runs",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 does not state initial densities or whether the three volume-fraction runs are initialized independently or continued from one another.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize each run independently with every density equal to its target Vf.",
        "Initialize each run with every density equal to 1.",
        "Warm-start the lower-volume runs from the preceding higher-volume solution, rescaled to the new volume."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Topology density-update step controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 1.3.1 and 2.1 supply no topology move limit or damping rule. The later frame-optimization settings do not determine these controls.",
      "readings": [
        "Limit each density change to 0.2 per iteration with no additional damping.",
        "Limit each density change to 0.05 per iteration with no additional damping.",
        "Use no explicit density move limit and let a line search control the step."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Topology convergence and stopping test",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The Fig. 2 caption specifies a maximum of 200 iterations but no early stopping criterion. The 1e-4 tolerances later reported apply to size/layout/frame optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Run exactly 200 iterations.",
        "Stop when the maximum element-density change is below 0.01, with a 200-iteration cap.",
        "Stop when relative compliance change is below 1e-4, with a 200-iteration cap."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Equilibrium solver and numerical accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (2) specifies equilibrium, but the text does not identify the linear solver or its accuracy settings. These can affect numerical reproduction without changing the intended mathematical problem.",
      "readings": [
        "Use a double-precision sparse direct solver.",
        "Use diagonally preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-6.",
        "Use diagonally preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-10."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
